title: Veterans Pension Limit for Veterans in Medicaid-Covered Nursing Homes
content:
A veteran whose Veterans Pension rate category is one to which the Medicaid nursing-home limit applies, and who resides in a Medicaid-approved nursing home with Medicaid covering the cost, is paid no more than the product's monthly Medicaid nursing-home limit per month, starting with the first month after the product's number of full months (0) following the month of admission. The limit does not apply to a veteran with a spouse or child. Leaving the facility or losing Medicaid coverage ends the limit from the first day of the following month.

## Conditions, all of which must hold for the limit

| Condition | Evidence |
|---|---|
| The rate category is one to which the limit applies (a no-dependent category) | the rate category on the award |
| The veteran resides in a Medicaid-approved nursing home | the facility residence |
| Medicaid covers the cost | the Medicaid coverage |
| The month is on or after the first month after the full months following admission | the month of admission |

The limit does not apply to a veteran with a spouse or child, whatever the facility.

## End of the limit

| Event | Limit ends |
|---|---|
| The veteran leaves the facility | from the first day of the following month |
| Medicaid coverage is lost | from the first day of the following month |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A veteran in Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents) is admitted to a Medicaid-approved nursing home in August with Medicaid covering the cost. With 0 full months to wait, the limit governs from September: the monthly pension for September is no more than USD 90. He leaves the facility on November 20; the limit ends from December 1, and December is paid at the rate otherwise due.
